# coolify_services (Data Source)

Lists every service of the token's team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_services" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) All services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.
- `type` (String) One-click service type (empty for compose services).
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
